subject: Staged burn escrow for trial credits & commit ramp
messages:
From: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwoodinference.com>
To: Sofia Ramos <sofia.ramos@cloudstitch.com>
Cc: marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com, aditya.rao@redwoodinference.com
Date: Fri, 20 Nov 2026 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Staged burn escrow for trial credits & commit ramp

Hi Sofia —

Thanks again for taking the call yesterday. As discussed, CloudStitch is interested in a short POC where we provide hosted API credits to get you through integration and initial user-testing. You mentioned procurement prefers an escrow-style structure so spend is staged against milestones rather than a single up-front credit.

To move quickly, I wanted to propose a concrete starting point so your procurement/legal team has something to review:

- Total pilot credits: $60k (per-token equivalent) placed in escrow
- Duration: 90 days from effective date
- Stage releases: 50% up-front on signing, 30% upon environment acceptance (dev->prod validation), 20% on successful completion of agreed evals or 2-week production smoke test
- If CloudStitch executes a 6-month commit within 45 days of pilot completion we will convert remaining escrowed credits and apply a one-time onboarding promo of +10% bonus credits

I attached a short one-page term stub (pilot_credit_tos.pdf) and a redline-friendly Word doc if you prefer to mark changes. Can you share the procurement contact and a rough preferred milestone phrasing so we can tailor? Also note SOC2 evidence and standard security addenda are available in our portal — happy to push those to procurement.

Next steps I suggest:
1) You share your procurement contact and any mandatory legal language
2) We send a DocuSign with the pilot escrow term stub for your legal to redline
3) We schedule a short alignment call (15m) once redlines are in

Thanks — looking forward to moving this to signature so your engineers can get started.

Best,
Jonas Weber
Enterprise Sales
Redwood Inference
Mobile: +1 (415) 555-0198

Attachment: pilot_credit_tos.pdf (PDF, 120KB)

From: Sofia Ramos <sofia.ramos@cloudstitch.com>
To: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: procurement@cloudstitch.com
Date: Mon, 23 Nov 2026 10:34:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Staged burn escrow for trial credits & commit ramp

Hi Jonas —

Thanks for the proposal and the clear milestones — that format looks promising. A few notes from procurement/legal on their first pass:

- Escrow period: procurement prefers 120 days rather than 90 so there is room for scheduling regressions and extended integration windows
- Release triggers: they want the second release tied to a measurable acceptance test (we can share a short checklist), not just "environment acceptance"
- They also asked for a clause that refunds unused credits pro rata if we explicitly decline to continue after the pilot

On the commercial side, the team would consider the onboarding +10% bonus credits attractive if the conversion to a 6-month commit includes a minimum monthly usage floor (they will propose a lower of X or Y formula). Can you confirm whether Redwood is ok with a short refund clause and if the bonus can be delivered as immediate credit rather than future discount?

Procurement: procurement@cloudstitch.com will coordinate redlines. Please send the Word doc to them and mark the DocuSign as "Pilot Credit Escrow - CloudStitch".

Sofia Ramos
Head of Platform Partnerships
CloudStitch

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
To: Sofia Ramos <sofia.ramos@cloudstitch.com>, procurement@cloudstitch.com
Cc: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwoodinference.com>, aditya.rao@redwoodinference.com
Date: Wed, 25 Nov 2026 14:07:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Staged burn escrow for trial credits & commit ramp

Hi Sofia / CloudStitch procurement team —

Appreciate the clarity. I've attached a draft escalation term (pilot_credit_escalation_term.docx) that captures the refund language and a checklist-based acceptance trigger. Key commercial confirmations below so your team can see the tradeoffs:

- Escrow period: we can extend to 120 days (no problem).
- Staged releases: 50% on signature; 30% on checklist-based acceptance (we suggest a 10-item integration checklist); 20% on successful completion or conversion to commit.
- Refunds: unused credits will be refunded pro rata to the purchaser if CloudStitch elects to terminate after the pilot and before conversion. Refunds exclude credits used for latency/cost overages outside normal use.
- Bonus credits: onboarding +10% will be applied as an immediate credit at conversion time. We can discuss applying a portion up-front if that materially helps timelines, but our standard is to award on conversion.
- Conversion mechanics: if CloudStitch signs a 6-month usage commit within 45 days of pilot completion, remaining escrowed funds convert to committed credit at the agreed per-token discount and the +10% onboarding bonus is added.

DocuSign: I've created a DocuSign envelope and placed the Word draft inside so procurement can redline directly there: https://www.docusign.com/transaction/ABC1234

I'll leave the legal redlines to procurement — once we have those we'll get finance to run the economics model and propose per-token tiers tied to the commit size.

Best,
Marissa Cole
Account Executive, Strategic Sales
Redwood Inference

Attachment: pilot_credit_escalation_term.docx (DOCX, 45KB)

From: Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwoodinference.com>
To: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwoodinference.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Mon, 29 Nov 2026 16:45:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Staged burn escrow for trial credits & commit ramp

Quick internal note before we finalize:

- Economics: attach economics_model.xlsx which maps per-token effective price at different commit tiers (monthly and 6-month). We should avoid giving a steep first-year-only discount that anchors the account — prefer a conservative per-token discount at pilot conversion and layer volume breakpoints.
- Refund clause: ok to accept the pro rata refund, but cap refund processing time to 30 days and exclude refunds if credits were used in breach of the TOS.
- Bonus credits: recommend committing to +10% at conversion but offer a one-time 5% up-front bridge credit if CloudStitch signs within 7 days of pilot start (helps with adoption).

Marissa/Jonas — once procurement returns redlines, please pass to finance (cc aditya) so we can run the final per-token schedule. I'll be available on the call if legal pushes back on refund language.

-A
Aditya Rao
Manager, Strategic Sales Ops
Redwood Inference

Attachment: economics_model.xlsx (XLSX, 38KB)
